key_insight: GDGraph converts radiology guidelines into executable decision graphs, improving case-evaluation accuracy while making decision paths traceable.
clinical_relevance: The framework could support more consistent imaging-based risk stratification and management planning, but the reported evaluation does not establish clinical safety or patient benefit.
method: An LLM partitions guidelines into sections and extracts decision subgraphs with linked definitions.
Related branches are compiled into an executable decision graph.
A fast System One model answers localized questions while deterministic traversal resolves Boolean logic.
evidence_signal: Across 347 cases covering renal cysts, adnexal masses, and thyroid nodules, GDGraph raised System One accuracy from 57.3% to 90.8%, versus 80.1% for retrieval-augmented GPT-4o and 82.7% for graph-guided GPT-4o with chain-of-thought, with lower reported latency and cost.
watch_item: Guideline-to-graph compilation errors could propagate into recommendations; prospective clinical validation is not reported in the abstract.
paper_title: Radiology Guideline-derived Decision Graph for Efficient Clinical Decision Support
